author: Primal Space
description:
You might have heard the story about the King found in a carpark… but there’s more to it.

Richard III’s skeleton was found only 6 hours into the excavation and so the process of DNA testing began to make sure it was him. Mitochondrial DNA tests work best when tracing lineage from women, but if even one link was wrong, it could throw off the whole investigation - and so the team had to get creative.
title: DNA Testing Richard III
